  let s := Finset.Icc 2 ⌊Real.exp (2*a.1)⌋₊

      (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) * (centralInterval a.1).indicator (fun x =>
        (if Real.log n ≤ a.1-x then (Real.exp (x/2) : ℂ) else 0) +
        (if Real.log n ≤ a.1+x then (Real.exp (x/2) / n : ℂ) else 0)) x := by
    by_cases hn : n ∈ s
    · have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)
        (ccmPrimeTransportOperator a n p : SoninL2),
        ccmPrimeTransport_polarPlus_coeFn a hn2] with x hs ht _

      rw [hs]
      change (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) *
        (ccmPrimeTransportOperator a n p : SoninL2) x = _

  rw [hs]

        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro n hn
        rw [ha n hn, indicator_of_mem hx]

        rw [sum_log_cutoff a _ (by linarith [hx'.1]),
          sum_log_cutoff a _ (by linarith [hx'.2]), psi_eq_sum_from_two,
          ccmReciprocalMangoldtCumulative]
        push_cast
        rfl
  · rw [indicator_of_notMem hx]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro n hn
    rw [ha n hn, indicator_of_notMem hx, mul_zero]

theorem coprimeDensity_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    coprimeDensity p = 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  rw [coprimeDensity_eq_totient_div, Nat.totient_prime hp,
    Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le, Nat.cast_one]
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne_zero
  field_simp

theorem coprimeDensity_mul_of_coprime {Q R : ℕ} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (hQR : Q.Coprime R) :
    coprimeDensity (Q * R) = coprimeDensity Q * coprimeDensity R := by
  haveI : NeZero Q := ⟨hQ⟩
  haveI : NeZero R := ⟨hR⟩
  rw [coprimeDensity_eq_totient_div, coprimeDensity_eq_totient_div,
    coprimeDensity_eq_totient_div, Nat.totient_mul hQR, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
  ring

private theorem coprimeDensity_prime_square {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    coprimeDensity (p * p) = 1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  have ht : (p * p).totient = p * (p - 1) := by
    simpa [pow_two] using Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ hp 1
  rw [coprimeDensity_eq_totient_div, ht, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le, Nat.cast_one]
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne_zero
  field_simp

theorem coprimeDensity_prime_covariance {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) :
    coprimeDensity (p * q) - coprimeDensity p * coprimeDensity q =
      if p = q then ((p : ℝ) - 1) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0 := by
  by_cases he : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl, coprimeDensity_prime_square hp, coprimeDensity_prime hp]
    have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne_zero
    field_simp
    ring
  · rw [if_neg he, coprimeDensity_mul_of_coprime hp.ne_zero hq.ne_zero
      ((Nat.coprime_primes hp hq).mpr he), sub_self]

theorem coprimeCovariance_primes_diagonal (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) (c : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ p ∈ S, ∑ q ∈ S, c p * c q *
      (coprimeDensity (p * q) - coprimeDensity p * coprimeDensity q)) =
      ∑ p ∈ S, c p ^ 2 * (((p : ℝ) - 1) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · rw [coprimeDensity_prime_covariance (hS p hp) (hS p hp), if_pos rfl]
    ring
  · intro q hq hqp
    rw [coprimeDensity_prime_covariance (hS p hp) (hS q hq), if_neg (Ne.symm hqp), mul_zero]
  · exact fun h => (h hp).elim

/-- A simultaneous finite Bessel bound for actual prime deletion endpoints. -/
theorem exists_forward_prime_deletion_variance {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ (V : ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        ‖sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 V) ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r Q ∧
        Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r Q : ℂ))) ∧
      ∀ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) →
        ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 *
          (∑ p ∈ S, (p : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((p : ℝ) - 1) *
            (r p - (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ 2) ≤ V := by
  obtain ⟨V, r, hV0, hV, hr, hcov⟩ := exists_forward_coprime_covariance hW
  refine ⟨V, r, hV0, hV, hr, ?_⟩
  intro S hS
  let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => (p : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => r p - (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)
  let T : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ S, w p * d p ^ 2
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := Finset.sum_nonneg fun p hp =>
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (hS p hp).one_lt
      linarith)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hb := hcov S (fun p hp => (hS p hp).ne_zero) (fun p => w p * d p)
  rw [coprimeCovariance_primes_diagonal S hS] at hb
  have hlin : (∑ p ∈ S, w p * d p * (r p - coprimeDensity p)) = T := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    rw [coprimeDensity_prime (hS p hp)]
    change w p * d p * d p = w p * d p ^ 2
    ring
  have hquad : (∑ p ∈ S, (w p * d p) ^ 2 * (((p : ℝ) - 1) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2)) = T := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (hS p hp).ne_zero
    have hp1 : (p : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (hS p hp).one_lt
      linarith
    dsimp [w]
    field_simp
  rw [hlin, hquad] at hb
  change ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 * T ≤ V
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · simpa only [hT, mul_zero] using hV0
  have hTp : 0 < T := lt_of_le_of_ne hT0 (Ne.symm hT)
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hTp).mp
  nlinarith only [hb]

/-!
# The integer atomic floor of the canonical Weil measure

The floor of every actual singleton mass defines a dominated integer-valued atomic submeasure.
Its complement is a positive measure with every atom below one. Exact subtraction is proved on
finite-mass measurable sets by restricting before invoking finite measure cancellation. No
atomicity, discreteness, or total-mass assumption on the canonical source is supplied.
-/

open Set Filter MeasureTheory

/-- Integer part of the actual canonical singleton mass. -/
def quantizationIntegerWeight {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊(boundaryMeasure hW).real {r}⌋₊

/-- The canonical integer atomic floor, with no atomicity assumption on the source. -/
def quantizationIntegerMeasure {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : Measure ℝ :=
  Measure.sum fun r : ℝ => (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) • Measure.dirac r

/-- Positive residual measure after removal of the actual integer atomic floor. -/
def quantizationResidualMeasure {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : Measure ℝ :=
  boundaryMeasure hW - quantizationIntegerMeasure hW

theorem quantizationIntegerWeight_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) :
    (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ boundaryMeasure hW {r} := by
  calc
    (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((boundaryMeasure hW).real {r}) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Nat.floor_le ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    _ ≤ boundaryMeasure hW {r} := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW s =
      ∑' r : ℝ, ((s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW) r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure, Measure.sum_apply _ hs]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro r
  by_cases hr : r ∈ s <;> simp [Measure.smul_apply, hr]

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW ≤ boundaryMeasure hW := by
  classical
  refine Measure.le_iff.mpr fun s hs => ?_
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs, ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_sum]
  refine iSup_le fun F => ?_
  calc
    ∑ r ∈ F, ((s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW) r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
        ∑ r ∈ F, (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s {r} := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      by_cases hr : r ∈ s
      · simpa [Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_singleton r),
          singleton_inter_of_mem hr, hr] using quantizationIntegerWeight_le hW r
      · simp [hr, Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_singleton r),
          singleton_inter_of_notMem hr]
    _ = (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s (F : Set ℝ) := sum_measure_singleton
    _ ≤ (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s univ := measure_mono (subset_univ _)
    _ = boundaryMeasure hW s := by simp

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_singleton {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW {r} = (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) :=
  Measure.sum_smul_dirac_singleton

/-- Finite source mass forces a finite sum of natural-valued atomic weights. -/
theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_nat {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hfin : boundaryMeasure hW s ≠ ∞) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, quantizationIntegerMeasure hW s = n := by
  classical
  let f : ℝ → ℕ := s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW)
  have hf : ∑' r : ℝ, (f r : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := by
    rw [← quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs]
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfin (quantizationIntegerMeasure_le hW s)
  have hF : (Function.support f).Finite := by
    apply (ENNReal.finite_const_le_of_tsum_ne_top hf (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)).subset
    intro r hr
    change (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (f r : ℝ≥0∞)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hr
  refine ⟨∑ r ∈ hF.toFinset, f r, ?_⟩
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs]
  change (∑' r : ℝ, (f r : ℝ≥0∞)) = ((∑ r ∈ hF.toFinset, f r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)
  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := hF.toFinset)]
  · simp
  · intro r hr
    have hz : f r = 0 := by simpa using hr
    simp [hz]

theorem quantizationResidualMeasure_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationResidualMeasure hW ≤ boundaryMeasure hW := Measure.sub_le

/-- The subtraction identity is paid locally, where the integer floor is finite. -/
theorem quantizationResidualMeasure_add_integer {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hfin : boundaryMeasure hW s ≠ ∞) :
    quantizationResidualMeasure hW s + quantizationIntegerMeasure hW s = boundaryMeasure hW s := by
  let μ := boundaryMeasure hW

paperCauchySample (μ - χ) k n - paperCauchySample (ν - χ) k n := by

  have hν := integral_add_measure (kernel_integrable (ν - χ) k n) (kernel_integrable χ k n)

  rw [Measure.sub_add_cancel_of_le hχν] at hν

private theorem sample_sum_abs_sub_le_common {μ ν χ : Measure ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure χ]
    (hχμ : χ ≤ μ) (hχν : χ ≤ ν) (k : ℕ) (s : Finset ℤ) :
    (∑ n ∈ s, |paperCauchySample μ k n - paperCauchySample ν k n|) ≤
      (2 + Real.pi / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) * (μ.real univ + ν.real univ - 2 * χ.real univ) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ s, (paperCauchySample (μ - χ) k n + paperCauchySample (ν - χ) k n) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n _
      rw [sample_sub_common hχμ hχν]
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans_eq (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (paperCauchySample_nonneg _ _ _),
        abs_of_nonneg (paperCauchySample_nonneg _ _ _)])
    _ ≤ (2 + Real.pi / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) *
        ((μ - χ).real univ + (ν - χ).real univ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
      exact add_le_add (sample_sum_le (μ - χ) k s) (sample_sum_le (ν - χ) k s)
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      simp only [measureReal_def, Measure.sub_apply MeasurableSet.univ hχμ,
        Measure.sub_apply MeasurableSet.univ hχν,
        ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le (hχμ univ) (measure_ne_top μ univ),
        ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le (hχν univ) (measure_ne_top ν univ)]
      ring

/-- Every finite set of sample discrepancies is paid once by the actual common mass. -/
theorem sum_abs_deficitWindow_cauchy_sub_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (k : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ) :
    (∑ n ∈ s, |paperCauchySample ((boundaryMeasure hW).restrict (Ioc 0 T)) k n -
      paperCauchySample (deficitOrdinateMeasure.restrict (Ioc 0 T)) k n|) ≤
      (2 + Real.pi / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) *
        ((boundaryMeasure hW).real (Ioc 0 T) - (finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card +
          2 * deficitCount hW T) := by
  haveI := isFiniteMeasure_deficitBoundaryWindow hW T
  haveI := isFiniteMeasure_deficitOrdinateWindow T
  haveI := isFiniteMeasure_deficitSharedWindow hW T
  have h := sample_sum_abs_sub_le_common
    (Measure.restrict_mono_measure (deficitSharedMeasure_le_boundary hW) (Ioc 0 T))
    (Measure.restrict_mono_measure (deficitSharedMeasure_le_ordinate hW) (Ioc 0 T)) k s
  have hν : (deficitOrdinateMeasure.restrict (Ioc 0 T)).real univ =
      ((finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card : ℝ) := by
    rw [measureReal_restrict_apply_univ, measureReal_def, deficitOrdinateMeasure_Ioc,
      ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
  have hχ : ((deficitSharedMeasure hW).restrict (Ioc 0 T)).real univ =
      ((finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card : ℝ) - deficitCount hW T := by
    rw [measureReal_restrict_apply_univ, deficitSharedMeasure_real_Ioc]
  rw [hν, hχ, measureReal_restrict_apply_univ] at h
  convert h using 1
  ring

/-- The entire Cauchy-sampled discrepancy is in `ℓ¹`. -/
theorem summable_abs_deficitWindow_cauchy_sub {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (k : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℤ =>
      |paperCauchySample ((boundaryMeasure hW).restrict (Ioc 0 T)) k n -
        paperCauchySample (deficitOrdinateMeasure.restrict (Ioc 0 T)) k n|) :=
  summable_of_sum_le (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (sum_abs_deficitWindow_cauchy_sub_le hW k T)

/-- Simultaneous recovery bound for all integer sites, with no sample-count loss. -/
theorem tsum_abs_deficitWindow_cauchy_sub_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (k : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    (∑' n : ℤ, |paperCauchySample ((boundaryMeasure hW).restrict (Ioc 0 T)) k n -
      paperCauchySample (deficitOrdinateMeasure.restrict (Ioc 0 T)) k n|) ≤
      (2 + Real.pi / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) *
        ((boundaryMeasure hW).real (Ioc 0 T) - (finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card +
          2 * deficitCount hW T) :=
  Real.tsum_le_of_sum_le (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (sum_abs_deficitWindow_cauchy_sub_le hW k T)

private theorem norm_integral_sub_le_common_mass {μ ν χ : Measure ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure χ]
    (hχμ : χ ≤ μ) (hχν : χ ≤ ν) {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f)
    (hb : ∀ r, ‖f r‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖(∫ r, f r ∂μ) - ∫ r, f r ∂ν‖ ≤ μ.real univ + ν.real univ - 2 * χ.real univ := by
  have hi : ∀ ξ : Measure ℝ, IsFiniteMeasure ξ → Integrable f ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    letI := hξ
    exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall hb)
  have hμ := integral_add_measure (hi (μ - χ) inferInstance) (hi χ inferInstance)
  have hν := integral_add_measure (hi (ν - χ) inferInstance) (hi χ inferInstance)
  rw [Measure.sub_add_cancel_of_le hχμ] at hμ
  rw [Measure.sub_add_cancel_of_le hχν] at hν
  calc
    ‖(∫ r, f r ∂μ) - ∫ r, f r ∂ν‖ =
        ‖(∫ r, f r ∂(μ - χ)) - ∫ r, f r ∂(ν - χ)‖ := by
      rw [hμ, hν]
      congr 1
      abel
    _ ≤ ‖∫ r, f r ∂(μ - χ)‖ + ‖∫ r, f r ∂(ν - χ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ (μ - χ).real univ + (ν - χ).real univ := by
      apply add_le_add <;>
        simpa only [one_mul] using norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (Eventually.of_forall hb)
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [measureReal_def, Measure.sub_apply MeasurableSet.univ hχμ,
        Measure.sub_apply MeasurableSet.univ hχν,
        ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le (hχμ univ) (measure_ne_top μ univ),
        ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le (hχν univ) (measure_ne_top ν univ)]
      ring

theorem norm_deficitWindow_fourier_sub_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    (k T : ℝ) :
    ‖(∫ r in Ioc 0 T, Complex.exp (((k * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ∂boundaryMeasure hW) -
        ∫ r in Ioc 0 T, Complex.exp (((k * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ∂deficitOrdinateMeasure‖ ≤
      (boundaryMeasure hW).real (Ioc 0 T) - ((finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card : ℝ) +
        2 * deficitCount hW T := by
  haveI := isFiniteMeasure_deficitBoundaryWindow hW T
  haveI := isFiniteMeasure_deficitOrdinateWindow T
  haveI := isFiniteMeasure_deficitSharedWindow hW T
  have hc : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => Complex.exp (((k * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) := by fun_prop
  have hb : ∀ r : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (((k * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ 1 := fun r =>
    (Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (k * r)).le
  have h := norm_integral_sub_le_common_mass
    (Measure.restrict_mono_measure (deficitSharedMeasure_le_boundary hW) (Ioc 0 T))
    (Measure.restrict_mono_measure (deficitSharedMeasure_le_ordinate hW) (Ioc 0 T)) hc hb
  have hν : (deficitOrdinateMeasure.restrict (Ioc 0 T)).real univ =
      ((finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card : ℝ) := by
    rw [measureReal_restrict_apply_univ, measureReal_def, deficitOrdinateMeasure_Ioc,
      ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
  have hχ : ((deficitSharedMeasure hW).restrict (Ioc 0 T)).real univ =
      ((finite_deficitWindow T).toFinset.card : ℝ) - deficitCount hW T := by
    rw [measureReal_restrict_apply_univ, deficitSharedMeasure_real_Ioc]
  rw [hν, hχ, measureReal_restrict_apply_univ] at h
  convert h using 1
  ring

/-!
# Vanishing mean-square tests with fixed resonance response

The exact source energy produces finite exponential polynomials with mean
square tending to zero and height-one resonance response equal to one. Thus
unweighted mean-square approximation cannot support a continuous extension
of the normalized resonance functional.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology GaloisForLFunctions
open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry
open scoped ComplexConjugate

noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSpectral

def quantizationResonancePolynomial (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, p n * bohrExp (-2 * Real.log n) t

theorem continuous_quantizationResonancePolynomial (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    Continuous (quantizationResonancePolynomial p N) :=
  continuous_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => continuous_const.mul (continuous_bohrExp _)

theorem isBohrAlmostPeriodic_quantizationResonancePolynomial (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    IsBohrAlmostPeriodic (quantizationResonancePolynomial p N) :=
  isBohrAlmostPeriodic_sum _
    (fun _ _ => continuous_const.mul (continuous_bohrExp _))
    (fun _ _ => isBohrAlmostPeriodic_const_mul _ (isBohrAlmostPeriodic_bohrExp _))

/-- The critical logarithmic frequencies are distinct, so mean square equals
coefficient square norm exactly. -/
theorem quantizationResonancePolynomial_mean (p : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) :
    bohrMean (fun t => quantizationResonancePolynomial p N t *
      conj (quantizationResonancePolynomial p N t)) =
        ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖p n‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  classical
  let P := quantizationResonancePolynomial p N
  have hc : Continuous P := continuous_quantizationResonancePolynomial p N
  have ha : IsBohrAlmostPeriodic P := isBohrAlmostPeriodic_quantizationResonancePolynomial p N
  have hcoef (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
      bohrCoefficient P (-2 * Real.log j) = p j := by
    rw [show P = fun t => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      p n * bohrExp (-2 * Real.log n) t from rfl, bohrCoefficient_trigPoly]
    have hinj (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N) :
        -2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) = -2 * Real.log j ↔ n = j := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hlog : Real.log (n : ℝ) = Real.log j := by linarith
        have he := congrArg Real.exp hlog
        rw [Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1; omega)),
          Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < j by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1; omega))] at he
        exact_mod_cast he
      · rintro rfl
        rfl
    calc
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, if n = j then p n else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => by simp only [hinj n hn]
      _ = p j := by simp [hj]
  have hsplit : (fun t => P t * conj (P t)) = fun t =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, conj (p n) * (P t * bohrChar (-2 * Real.log n) t) := by
    funext t
    change P t * conj (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, p n * bohrExp (-2 * Real.log n) t) = _
    rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => by rw [map_mul, conj_bohrExp]; ring
  change bohrMean (fun t => P t * conj (P t)) = _
  rw [hsplit, bohrMean_sum (F := fun n => fun t =>
    conj (p n) * (P t * bohrChar (-2 * Real.log n) t)) _
    (fun n _ => continuous_const.mul (hc.mul (continuous_bohrChar _)))
    (fun n _ => isBohrAlmostPeriodic_const_mul _ (isBohrAlmostPeriodic_mul_bohrChar hc ha _))]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  rw [bohrMean_const_mul (f := fun t => P t * bohrChar (-2 * Real.log n) t)
    _ (hc.mul (continuous_bohrChar _))
    (isBohrAlmostPeriodic_mul_bohrChar hc ha _)]
  change conj (p n) * bohrCoefficient P (-2 * Real.log n) = _
  rw [hcoef n hn, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

/-- A sequence of actual critical resonance tests has vanishing mean square,
while its normalized source response is eventually exactly one. -/
theorem exists_quantization_resonance_discontinuity {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ,
      Tendsto (fun N => (bohrMean (fun t => quantizationResonancePolynomial (p N) N t *
        conj (quantizationResonancePolynomial (p N) N t))).re) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ N in atTop, (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        p N n * quantizationFrequencyResidue lam (-2 * Real.log n) 1) = 1 := by
  let E := quantizationResonanceEnergy lam 0
  let p : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ := fun N n => conj (quantizationCenteredResonance lam 0 n) / (E N : ℂ)
  have hE : Tendsto E atTop atTop := tendsto_quantization_resonance_energy hW
  have hn (N : ℕ) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ‖p N n‖ ^ 2) = (E N)⁻¹ := by
    calc

      Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_pow, hpow]

    rfl
